spreadsheetUrl.title: Google Sheet URL
spreadsheetUrl.description: Sheet with one property per row. It must be shared as "Anyone with the link can view". A direct CSV URL works too. Coordinate, ID and address columns are detected automatically.

searchTerm.title: Search term
searchTerm.description: What to search for on Google Maps. A place counts only if its name contains this text (case-insensitive).

bufferMeters.title: Search buffer (meters)
bufferMeters.description: How far around each property to look for stores. A property at the edge of the set can have its nearest store outside the properties' own area, so a small buffer gives wrong results silently. Keep it above the largest nearest-store distance you expect.

maxStoresToScrape.title: Max stores to scrape
maxStoresToScrape.description: Cost cap for Google Maps Scraper. Leave empty for no limit (recommended): a capped scrape misses stores, which makes nearest-store results wrong.

latitudeColumn.title: Latitude column
latitudeColumn.sectionDescription: Only needed if auto-detection picks the wrong columns.
